Decisions differ ibger, : value numeric. IBGE encodes missingness special strings, ibger keeps value character. MI Social returns JSON numbers encodes absence leaving field document, absent fields simply produce row. Zeros always zeros. API returns 0 months yet published. Rather silently dropping , mds_data() returns published mds_drop_unpublished() applies rule explicitly (rule BDE collector etl/fontes/coletores/mds.R). Field validation asks data, schema. Solr schema dynamic fields (*_i, *_f, …), suffixed name “defined”. field accepted least one document (numFound > 0). server labels JSON text/plain, responses parsed check_type = FALSE. Labels Portuguese, source; dictionary lives CSV R code stays ASCII Python sibling reads file. Fail loudly inputs widen narrow query. empty locality vector mean “filter”, .e. whole country; wrong check digit silently become another municipality. errors (0.2.1), text fields, whose values otherwise become NA vanish long output. empty page end. Paging stops numFound reached; empty page , Solr’s partialResults response without response error. Unpublished months can judged whole country. mds_drop_unpublished(reference = "brazil") reads last month non-zero value mds_periods(), small selection keeps legitimate trailing zeros. One response contract, checked anything else (0.3.0). Data pages, counts facets go check_response() (R/resposta.R) interpreted cached; every document must carry valid municipality month one value per field. failure source can therefore never become “data” rest session, shift value another municipality. Repetition fine, contradiction . Observations repeated value dropped; different values key misocialr_error_conflict. Classification deletion. mds_drop_unpublished() never removes non-zero value, re-reads contradictory national reference, can flag (action = "flag"), inferring publication zeros heuristic, official date. POST, GET (0.3.1). Solr select handler answers form POST exactly like GET, long GET URL refused HTTP 414 (measured 8,000 characters). Municipality codes still split blocks 200 keep filter small. Retries tested real server. httr2’s mocked responses Python’s responses return retry loop, retry tests use local HTTP server (webfakes R, http.server Python). packages make 3 tries total. Behaviour parity tested, assumed. tests/testthat/paridade/ casos.json lists inputs expected outputs error classes; test suites run (Python copy kept sincronizar_python.py). Paging cursorMark (0.4.0). Pages walked sort key (id), documents added removed reading shift ; changing total repeated ids still errors, reading stops numFound without extra request. text: fields nature sums across municipalities, state total plain sum month:
code: state <- pbf |>   summarise(value = sum(value), .by = c(period, field)) |>   mutate(month = as.Date(paste0(period, "01"), "%Y%m%d"))  families <- filter(state,                    field == "qtd_familias_beneficiarias_bolsa_familia_i") ggplot(families, aes(month, value / 1e6)) +   geom_line(color = "#0b4d3c", linewidth = 0.8) +   geom_point(data = slice_tail(families, n = 1),              color = "#0b4d3c", size = 2) +   scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +   labs(     title = "Families receiving Bolsa Família in Pernambuco",     subtitle = "Millions of beneficiary families per month",     x = NULL, y = NULL,     caption = "Source: MDS/SAGI, MI Social."   ) +   theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +   theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

text: storage_type says value stored API (suffix _i, _l, _f, _d, _s), measures. API publishes data dictionary. labels mds_fields() reading technical names; 130 fields checked API (data-raw/check_dictionary.R). CRAS CREAS appear two themes (bpc_suas suas_rede). Cadastro Único income brackets disjoint sum: Brazil, 2025-08, poverty (19,452,231) + low income (7,828,004) = ½ minimum wage (27,280,235). “Low income” bracket poverty line ½ minimum wage. FNAS transfers: components sum total (PE, 2026-06: 7,625,605, including “fundo fundo” line; 2026-09: 11,684,831). account balances sum overall total; read one one. Components stopped published left (SUAS management since 2022, PSE média/alta since 2011, PAB since 2023). IGD-M: value without incentives + incentives = value incentives (PE, 2026-08). igdm_f index: sum across municipalities. Conditionalities (SICON, since 2023): education, monitored + information = target group (Recife, 2026-07: 110,464 + 16,896 = 127,360); health, children + women = people. Warning + blocking + suspension + cancellation = sanctions, BF (family benefit) BVA (benefit 16–17-year-olds), MDS Informe Bolsa Família . 44. External check: Brazil, 2024-03, equal Informe . 37 six numbers (BF 201,726 warnings, 80,543 blockings, 64,915 suspensions; BVA 74,853, 40,474 50,015); 2024-05 equal state table Informe . 44 (BF 230,466, 44,247 36,851). Cisterns cumulative counts: sum months. pbf_qtd_familias_quilombolas_benef_i pbf_qtd_familias_sit_rua_benef_i value every municipality month (PE 2020–2026: 14,615 14,615 pairs; Brazil 2025-09: 5,570 5,570, summing 283,923), Recife shows 1 homeless family. left dictionary source fixes . Cadastro Único month 2025-04 API (mds_periods("cadun_qtd_familias_cadastradas_i") jumps 202503 202505). pbf_qtd_familias_benef_i total Bolsa Família families (Recife, 2024-02: 9,847, 146,737 qtd_familias_beneficiarias_bolsa_familia_i). dictionary.

text: 'Tidyverse'-friendly interface 'MI Social' API Brazilian Ministry Development Social Assistance ('MDS', 'SAGI') https://aplicacoes.mds.gov.br/sagi/servicos/misocial. Retrieves monthly municipal series Cadastro Unico (registered families people income bracket), Bolsa Familia programme (beneficiary families, benefits transfers), 'BPC' benefit, social assistance network ('CRAS', 'CREAS' units), 'SUAS' funding, Bolsa Familia conditionalities food security programmes tidy long-format tibbles.

title: misocialr 0.3.1
text: Fixes final report 0.3.0 parallel verification (details REVISAO_FINAL_2026-10-19.md repository root). Queries POST. many months, fields codes, GET URL exceeded server limit (HTTP 414, reproduced 35 fields, 288 months 200 municipalities). query now goes body; query returned 136,989 rows. mds_drop_unpublished(action = "flag") keeps three classification columns also empty table (F2); datetime today read date; period follows calendar rule documents facets. Non-finite values ("NaN", "Inf", "1e999") response error; deduplication, missing value never replaces known one, order (F4). Documents facets month outside 01–12, facets repeated month, documents beyond numFound incoherent facets (n_nonzero larger n_localities, fresh read pair error) errors enter cache (F5). body JSON misocialr_error_response, original error parent (F6). Retry-capped 30 s per attempt 120 s total; options(misocialr.retry_backoff = ). Retries tested real local HTTP server (webfakes). parse_periods(): years 2000 year current one. parse_localities(): states always character; round numeric codes without scientific notation messages. Behaviour cases shared Python package (tests/testthat/paridade/casos.json). LICENSE.md full MIT text; data-raw/record_fixtures.R validates recorded response restores previous fixtures replacement fails. Suggests: jsonlite, webfakes.

title: misocialr 0.3.0
text: Fixes -depth analysis 0.2.1 (details REVISAO_PROFUNDA_2026-10-19.md repository root). Single response contract (check_response()): partial result, responseHeader$status 0, invalid numFound missing docs facet_counts errors, including mds_periods(), mds_localities() field check. complete responses enter cache (B1, B2, B8). mds_localities() pages, checks codes repetitions gains period refresh (B2). mds_drop_unpublished() never removes non-zero value: contradictory national reference queried , still contradictory, month kept warning (B3). period normalised checked month 01 12, including factor numeric (B6); field, today infinite values validated; missing value never treated zero (B7). New action = "flag" (M2). document without valid codigo_ibge anomes_s error (B4); non-scalar value error, without flattening lists (B5); two different values key conflict error (B4). requested municipality inside requested state queried twice. Paging: numFound changes pages repeated id errors (M5). mds_periods() sums facets disjoint blocks 200 codes (M4) gains refresh; canonical cache keys (M1). Classed errors (misocialr_error_validation, _response, _conflict, _http), status parent HTTP error; retry connection failure; version user agent; options(misocialr.quiet = TRUE) (M8). storage_type mds_fields() mds_api_fields(); unit "unknown" _s fields without suffix (M3). Local field validation even validate = FALSE (M7); warning municipality without documents (M9); ibge_code7() computes code (M6). DESCRIPTION: httr2 (>= 1.0.4), testthat (>= 3.2.1) (B9). data-raw/record_fixtures.R records temporary folder replaces fixtures checking result, keeping copy api.bak/ (B10). CI workflows .github/workflows/ (M10).
